# CAF Naming Convention -- Practical Guide

**Version**: 1.0
**Date**: 2026-03-18
**Applies to**: All infrastructure generated by the infrastructure generator
**Source**: Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Azure Resource Naming Rules

---

> A consistent naming convention is the foundation of a well-governed Azure environment.
> Without it, teams cannot identify resources by inspection, automation breaks on
> assumptions, and cost attribution becomes impossible. the infrastructure generator enforces CAF naming
> automatically -- this guide explains the rules.

## 1. Naming Format

### General Pattern

```
{prefix}-[org_code]-[business_unit]-{project}-{env}-{region}-[instance]
```

| Segment | Required | Description | Constraints |
|---------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| `prefix` | Yes | Resource type abbreviation (CAF) | 2-8 chars |
| `org_code` | ETI/Enterprise only | Organization short code | 2-8 chars, lowercase |
| `business_unit` | Enterprise only | Department / business unit | 2-8 chars, lowercase |
| `project` | Yes | Workload or project name | 3-15 chars, lowercase, hyphens |
| `env` | Yes | Environment stage | Fixed values (see section 7) |
| `region` | Yes | Azure region short code | Fixed values (see section 6) |
| `instance` | ETI/Enterprise only | Instance number | 3 digits, zero-padded |

### Rules

- All segments are forced to **lowercase** using `lower()` for Azure compatibility
- Empty optional segments are removed using `compact()` before `join("-")`
- Names are **deterministic**: same inputs always produce the same name
- Names are **readable**: an operator can identify resource, project, env, and region at a glance

---

## 2. The Three Modes

the infrastructure generator supports three naming modes adapted to organization size. The mode is
selected via the `naming_mode` variable.

### Mode PME (default)

For small and medium businesses. Compact names, no org code, no instance number.

```
{prefix}-{project}-{env}-{region}
```

**Example**: `kv-myapp-dev-weu`

### Mode ETI

For mid-size enterprises. Adds organization code and instance number.

```
{prefix}-{org}-{project}-{env}-{region}-{instance}
```

**Example**: `kv-acme-myapp-prd-weu-001`

### Mode Enterprise (Grand Compte)

For large enterprises with business units. Full naming with all segments.

```
{prefix}-{org}-{bu}-{project}-{env}-{region}-{instance}
```

**Example**: `kv-bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001`

### Comparison Table

| Resource | PME | ETI | Enterprise |
|----------|-----|-----|------------|
| Resource Group | `rg-myapp-dev-weu` | `rg-acme-myapp-prd-weu-001` | `rg-bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001` |
| VNet | `vnet-myapp-dev-weu` | `vnet-acme-myapp-prd-weu-001` | `vnet-bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001` |
| Key Vault | `kv-myapp-dev-weu` | `kv-acme-myapp-prd-weu-001` | `kv-bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001` |
| Storage | `stmyappdevweu7x3k` | `stacmemyappprdweu001a2b` | `stbnpffintrprdweuk9m2` |
| NSG | `nsg-myapp-dev-weu` | `nsg-acme-myapp-prd-weu-001` | `nsg-bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001` |
| Managed Identity | `id-myapp-dev-weu` | `id-acme-myapp-prd-weu-001` | `id-bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001` |
| Log Analytics | `log-myapp-dev-weu` | `log-acme-myapp-prd-weu-001` | `log-bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001` |

## 4. Terraform Locals Pattern

### Core Naming Locals

Every stack generates these locals in `main.tf`:

```hcl
# main.tf -- locals
locals {
  # Build name parts based on naming mode
  name_parts = compact([
    var.org_code,         # "" in PME mode -> removed by compact()
    var.business_unit,    # "" in PME/ETI mode -> removed by compact()
    var.project,
    var.environment,
    var.location_code,
    var.instance_number   # "" in PME mode -> removed by compact()
  ])

  # Standard prefix: "myapp-dev-weu" or "acme-myapp-prd-weu-001"
  name_prefix = lower(join("-", local.name_parts))

  # Slug for resources that don't allow hyphens (Storage Account)
  name_slug = lower(join("", [for s in local.name_parts : replace(s, "-", "")]))

  # Resource Group name
  rg_name = "rg-${local.name_prefix}"
}
```

### How compact() Works

The `compact()` function removes empty strings from a list. This is how optional
segments are handled:

```hcl
# PME mode: org_code = "", business_unit = "", instance_number = ""
compact(["", "", "myapp", "dev", "weu", ""])
# Result: ["myapp", "dev", "weu"]
# join("-"): "myapp-dev-weu"

# ETI mode: org_code = "acme", business_unit = "", instance_number = "001"
compact(["acme", "", "myapp", "prd", "weu", "001"])
# Result: ["acme", "myapp", "prd", "weu", "001"]
# join("-"): "acme-myapp-prd-weu-001"

# Enterprise mode: all segments present
compact(["bnpf", "fin", "trading", "prd", "weu", "001"])
# Result: ["bnpf", "fin", "trading", "prd", "weu", "001"]
# join("-"): "bnpf-fin-trading-prd-weu-001"
```

### Naming Variables

```hcl
# variables.tf
variable "project" {
  description = "Project or workload name"
  type        = string

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,14}$", var.project))
    error_message = "Project must be 3-15 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens."
  }
}

variable "environment" {
  description = "Deployment environment"
  type        = string

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["dev", "test", "uat", "staging", "prod", "dr"], var.environment)
    error_message = "Environment must be: dev, test, uat, staging, prod, or dr."
  }
}

variable "location_code" {
  description = "Short code for Azure region"
  type        = string
  default     = "weu"
}

variable "org_code" {
  description = "Organization short code (empty for PME mode)"
  type        = string
  default     = ""

  validation {
    condition     = var.org_code == "" || can(regex("^[a-z][a-z0-9]{1,7}$", var.org_code))
    error_message = "Org code must be empty or 2-8 lowercase alphanumeric characters."
  }
}

variable "business_unit" {
  description = "Business unit short code (empty for PME/ETI mode)"
  type        = string
  default     = ""

  validation {
    condition     = var.business_unit == "" || can(regex("^[a-z][a-z0-9]{1,7}$", var.business_unit))
    error_message = "Business unit must be empty or 2-8 lowercase alphanumeric characters."
  }
}

variable "instance_number" {
  description = "Instance number for multi-deployment (empty for PME mode)"
  type        = string
  default     = ""

  validation {
    condition     = var.instance_number == "" || can(regex("^[0-9]{3}$", var.instance_number))
    error_message = "Instance number must be empty or 3 zero-padded digits (e.g., 001)."
  }
}
```

## 5. Storage Account Special Rules

Storage accounts have unique naming constraints that differ from all other Azure resources:

| Constraint | Rule |
|-----------|------|
| Allowed characters | Lowercase letters and numbers only -- **no hyphens** |
| Maximum length | **24 characters** |
| Scope of uniqueness | **Globally unique** across all of Azure |
| Prefix | `st` (no hyphen after prefix) |

### Implementation

Because storage account names must be globally unique, the infrastructure generator appends a random
4-character suffix:

```hcl
# storage.tf
resource "random_string" "storage_suffix" {
  length  = 4
  special = false
  upper   = false
  numeric = true
  lower   = true
}

locals {
  # Remove hyphens and truncate to fit 24-char limit
  # "st" (2) + name_slug (max 18) + random (4) = max 24
  storage_name_base = substr(local.name_slug, 0, 18)
  storage_name      = "st${local.storage_name_base}${random_string.storage_suffix.result}"
}

module "storage" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-res-storage-storageaccount/azurerm"
  version = "~> 0.4"

  name                = local.storage_name
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  location            = var.location
  enable_telemetry    = false

  # ...
}
```

### Storage Name Examples

| Mode | name_slug | Random | Final Name | Length |
|------|-----------|--------|------------|--------|
| PME | `myappdevweu` | `7x3k` | `stmyappdevweu7x3k` | 18 |
| ETI | `acmemyappprdweu001` | `a2b9` | `stacmemyappprdweu0a2b9` | 23 |
| Enterprise | `bnpffintrprdweu001` | `k9m2` | `stbnpffintrprdweu0k9m2` | 23 |

> **Note**: The `name_slug` is truncated at 18 characters to ensure the total never
> exceeds 24 characters (2 for prefix + 18 for slug + 4 for random = 24).

| Code | Environment | Description |
|------|-------------|-------------|

| `test` | Testing | Automated test execution |
| `uat` | User Acceptance Testing | Pre-production validation |
| `staging` | Staging | Production mirror for final checks |
| `prod` | Production | Live, customer-facing |
| `dr` | Disaster Recovery | DR site (paired region) |

## 8. Enterprise Tags

The generator creates 17 enterprise tags organized in 4 categories. Tags are applied
to every resource via `local.common_tags`.

### Tag Categories

#### Identity and Ownership (6 tags)

| Tag Key | Description | Example | Source |
|---------|-------------|---------|--------|
| `environment` | Deployment environment | `prod` | `var.environment` |
| `project` | Project or workload name | `trading-platform` | `var.project` |
| `org_code` | Organization code | `bnpf` | `var.org_code` |
| `business_unit` | Business unit | `fin` | `var.business_unit` |
| `owner` | Team or person responsible | `platform-team@acme.com` | `var.owner` |
| `cost_center` | Finance cost center code | `CC-4521` | `var.cost_center` |

#### Security and Compliance (2 tags)

| Tag Key | Description | Example | Source |
|---------|-------------|---------|--------|
| `data_classification` | Data sensitivity level | `confidential` | `var.data_classification` |
| `confidentiality` | Confidentiality tier | `C2` | `var.confidentiality_level` |

#### Operations (6 tags)

| Tag Key | Description | Example | Source |
|---------|-------------|---------|--------|
| `managed_by` | Tool managing the resource | `terraform` | Static |
| `iac_source` | IaC platform | `terraform` | Static |
| `stack_type` | Type of stack | `appservice-postgresql` | From manifest |
| `stack_size` | Stack sizing tier | `standard` | `var.tier` |
| `tier` | Pricing/capability tier | `standard` | `var.tier` |
| `deployment_date` | Date of initial deployment | `2026-03-18` | `timestamp()` |

#### FinOps (3 tags)

| Tag Key | Description | Example | Source |
|---------|-------------|---------|--------|
| `criticality` | Business criticality | `high` | `var.criticality` |
| `operational_hours` | When the workload runs | `24x7` | `var.operational_hours` |
| `backup_policy` | Backup strategy | `daily-30d` | `var.backup_policy` |

### Terraform Implementation

```hcl
# main.tf -- common_tags local
locals {
  common_tags = {
    # Identity & Ownership
    environment   = var.environment
    project       = var.project
    org_code      = var.org_code
    business_unit = var.business_unit
    owner         = var.owner
    cost_center   = var.cost_center

    # Security & Compliance
    data_classification = var.data_classification
    confidentiality     = var.confidentiality_level

    # Operations
    managed_by      = "terraform"
    iac_source      = "terraform"
    stack_type      = var.stack_type
    stack_size      = var.tier
    tier            = var.tier
    deployment_date = formatdate("YYYY-MM-DD", timestamp())

    # FinOps
    criticality       = var.criticality
    operational_hours = var.operational_hours
    backup_policy     = var.backup_policy
  }
}
```

### Tag Variables

```hcl
# variables.tf -- enterprise tag variables
variable "owner" {
  description = "Team or person responsible for the resources"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "cost_center" {
  description = "Finance cost center code for billing attribution"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "data_classification" {
  description = "Data classification level"
  type        = string
  default     = "internal"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["public", "internal", "confidential", "restricted"], var.data_classification)
    error_message = "Data classification must be: public, internal, confidential, or restricted."
  }
}

variable "confidentiality_level" {
  description = "Confidentiality tier (C1=public, C2=internal, C3=confidential, C4=restricted)"
  type        = string
  default     = "C2"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"], var.confidentiality_level)
    error_message = "Confidentiality level must be: C1, C2, C3, or C4."
  }
}

variable "criticality" {
  description = "Business criticality of the workload"
  type        = string
  default     = "medium"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["low", "medium", "high", "critical"], var.criticality)
    error_message = "Criticality must be: low, medium, high, or critical."
  }
}

variable "operational_hours" {
  description = "When the workload is expected to run"
  type        = string
  default     = "business-hours"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["business-hours", "extended", "24x7"], var.operational_hours)
    error_message = "Operational hours must be: business-hours, extended, or 24x7."
  }
}

variable "backup_policy" {
  description = "Backup strategy for the workload"
  type        = string
  default     = "daily-30d"

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["none", "daily-7d", "daily-30d", "daily-90d", "daily-365d"], var.backup_policy)
    error_message = "Backup policy must be: none, daily-7d, daily-30d, daily-90d, or daily-365d."
  }
}
```

## 9. Examples by Mode

### PME Mode -- Startup Deploying a Web App

```hcl
# terraform.tfvars
project      = "saas-app"
environment  = "prod"
location     = "westeurope"
location_code = "weu"
tier         = "standard"
# org_code, business_unit, instance_number = "" (defaults)
```

Generated names:

| Resource | Name |
|----------|------|
| Resource Group | `rg-saas-app-prod-weu` |
| VNet | `vnet-saas-app-prod-weu` |
| NSG | `nsg-saas-app-prod-weu` |
| Key Vault | `kv-saas-app-prod-weu` |

```hcl
org_code        = "contoso"
```

### Enterprise Mode -- Large Bank with Business Units

```hcl

project         = "trading"
```
